metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant just said ‘Here, have this... don’t ask why’
metadata.description:
Wait, I actually got a kill?
Enemy must’ve been on a snack break.
Valorant logic: handing out freebies like it’s payday.
Click if your kills are happy accidents too!
